subject.title: Add Claw lifecycle CLI e2e coverage

question: Should OpenClaw core accept the Claws lifecycle CLI stack and keep this e2e coverage as the final proof slice?
rationale: The patch is test-only and appears technically sound, but it validates a new core CLI surface that is absent from current main and depends on multiple open RFC/stack PRs.

options.title: Review after dependencies
options.body: Leave this PR open and review it after the Claws RFC/dependency stack is accepted because it only validates commands introduced there.

options.title: Sponsor the stack now
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the Claws core CLI direction and move the dependency stack toward merge with this e2e PR as proof coverage.

options.title: Close with rejected stack
options.body: If maintainers decide Claws should not live in core, close this test-only PR together with the stack rather than landing standalone coverage.

recommendation.title: Review after dependencies
recommendation.body: Leave this PR open and review it after the Claws RFC/dependency stack is accepted because it only validates commands introduced there.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about accepting a new core CLI product surface, and CONTRIBUTING identifies steipete as the product-direction owner.
